info.description:
Two kinds of endpoint. The free proxy list and IP geolocation are open and key-free: rate limited per IP and sent with `access-control-allow-origin: *`, so they work from a browser as well as a server. The proxy list is published under CC BY 4.0 — attribution is the only condition.

The customer API under `/api/v1` is read-only and needs an API key, created under Settings in the dashboard and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. It returns proxy credentials, so it sends no CORS headers: call it from a server, never from browser code.
info.summary: Free proxy list and IP geolocation with no key; read-only account data with one.
info.title: Proxmint API
